name: 桌宠
description: 输入框上沿站着当前 agent 的宠物，跟着会话状态动；子代理各派一只到旁边干活。每个 agent 用哪只、宠物库都能自己改，也能让 agent 照描述或参考图生成新宠物。
author: t3-extensions

en.name: Desk pets
en.description: Pets for the current agent stand on the composer and react to the thread state; each subagent sends its own pet to work alongside. Choose a pet per agent, edit the pet library, or have an agent generate a new pet from a description or reference images.
